rationale.consistency: Mirrors CookieFilter exactly: reuses cookieFilterAction, same receiver kinds, OUTER label idiom, module ID naming, registered beside cookie, interface assertions added in all three blocks.
rationale.edge_cases: Unparseable lines pass through via stdlib Cookies(); exact case-sensitive name match; quoting preserved via Cookie.Quoted; attributes taken verbatim from first ';'. Leading whitespace before name is dropped on rewrite (minor).
rationale.scope: Does what was asked; only extra is a one-line compile-time Validator assertion for the pre-existing CookieFilter, harmless but not requested.
rationale.readability: Clear names, concise doc comments explaining the Set-Cookie shape and first-match semantics; helper replaceSetCookieValue isolates the rewrite logic.
rationale.robustness: No panics: len(cookies)==0 guarded, non-array fields returned unchanged, stdlib parser handles malformed input; per-value http.Response allocation is acceptable overhead.
rationale.maintainability: UnmarshalCaddyfile is a verbatim copy of CookieFilter's rather than a shared helper, though that duplication matches the existing filter pattern; rewrite logic is cleanly factored.
